segments.text: Suppose an instruction says: Bay three, six forty-five p.m., and bring printed ID. We can change its presentation while keeping those facts fixed.
segments.visual: Reveal ledger first; then three formats one at a time, preserving colored exact facts.

segments.text: But listen to this shorter version: Check in this evening. Bring your ID. Now the exact place, time, and printed-copy requirement have disappeared.
segments.visual: Replace full instruction with shorter wording. Point separately to missing place, time, printed requirement.

segments.text: There's another catch. If the supplied location is wrong, every format can repeat the same mistake. Agreement across formats doesn't verify the original fact.
segments.visual: Change ledger Bay 3 to Bay 9; propagate the same wrong input to all outputs.

segments.text: This is a fixed-template illustration. Preserving facts, checking their truth, and helping a reader understand are separate questions.
segments.visual: Close with three separate labels: preservation / correctness / comprehension.
